text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’d be glad to help design and model your optimization problem in Microsoft Excel Solver. I’m comfortable working with inputs defined together, structuring them into a clear solver-ready model, and building a practical solution for high-level production planning with constraints. I focus on making models organized, usable, and easy to adjust as requirements evolve.

I’m available and would be happy to discuss the scope on an intro call.

What key constraints and decision variables do you already have in mind for the optimization model?
